archetypes.name: step2b5-self-log
archetypes.rationale: Hot-path wrapper change must preserve stdout KVs while adding failure logging.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the Step 2b.5 wrapper path only. Check that non-zero `plan check-size` results self-log once, keep the original return code, and preserve stdout for prompt-side parsing. Pay special attention to rc=2, rc=3, pause short-circuit, and append-failure failure behavior. Cite each finding with file paths and line numbers. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
